convergence.exportInvocation: pen interactive --in <file.pen> --out <file.pen>; execute({ input: 'Export(["default","narrow-single-column"], "png", "<dir>")' }) — default scale 2; the .pen MUST sit at its committed lane path so the relative library import (../../../design-system/in-progress/hemlock-library.lib.pen) and font URL (../../fonts/Heebo-VariableFont_wght.ttf) resolve. Re-export verified byte-identical across three consecutive runs (both frames).
convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1, per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; contract pixelThreshold 0.03 is the Gate-1 story budget); targets = NORMALIZED prototype, contract root #cs-ov-types, Chromium (playwright 1.58), viewports 1280x1400 (default) / 480x1400 (narrow-single-column) per states.json story.viewport, deviceScaleFactor 2, --disable-lcd-text --font-render-hinting=none (GC-009 capture fact: grayscale-unhinted matches pen's rasterizer), fonts ready + double-rAF quiescence, animations/transitions frozen. ALIGNMENT: the default state's root y-offset is fractional (341.5 CSS px, per the states.json capture note), so the element screenshot clip-expands by one device row; the compare normalizes from the element box by locating the tile-0 top-border row (≈ catline-from) and cropping the exact 608-row content band from it. The narrow state is integer-aligned (880x1272 exact).
convergence.iterationNotes: Iteration 1 converged both states at ~0.003% (32 isolated single-pixel glyph-AA residuals per state, sub-threshold everywhere else). Two uncounted infra corrections to the compare harness itself, not the .pen: (a) the fractional-offset crop initially assumed a fixed 1-row expand and mis-aligned by one device row (full-width false diff at the border rows); replaced with the deterministic top-border-signature alignment above; (b) a geometry probe originally sampled inside the 12px corner arc where the border curves away; re-aimed at the straight left-edge segment. Gradient fidelity needed no densification: sRGB interpolation between the prototype's four authored stops deviates <0.6 RGB units from Chromium's oklch interpolation (measured with culori before authoring); Chromium's computed mid-stop values (oklch 0.667117/0.16993/266.833 at 30px, 0.772634/0.113023/268.271 at 50px) round-trip to the same hex culori derives (#658DFC, #96B2FE).
convergence.geometryProbesDetail: Probes derived from design-rules 1-6 and the states.json G-vectors, asserted on the exports: frame dims 2048x608 / 880x1272 (G1 grid 1024x304, G2 grid 440x636 at scale 2); tile origins (0,0)/(526,0)/(0,166)/(526,166) at default and (0,0)/(0,166)/(0,332)/(0,498) at narrow via top-border color transitions; per-tile top border row ≈ catline-from (#3A6AF8) and bottom border row ≈ catline-to (#C8D6FD) — the dark-on-top px-stop schedule 0/14/30/50/68 (design-rules 4); tile interiors white surface; 28px gaps white (backdrop shows through — no second border, no shadow, design-rules 3/6); tile-1 left border column at x=526 with white gap column beside it (column math 498+28).

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: caps category label text (h4, all tiles, both states)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: The label is NON-interactive brand-accent text; Hemlock has no dedicated eyebrow/label text role, and sem-text-action is the role that owns accent-colored text. Value-identity in BOTH modes (light #3A6AF8, dark #5A82F9 = Amanda's dark --accent exactly), so the bind is role-plausible and measured-correct; flagged because 'action' implies interactivity the tiles do not have (design-rules 10).

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: backdrop behind the grid gaps (frame fill)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: The contract root has no background of its own; the 28px gaps show the white page/card. In the GenUI serving context the component sits on mainPanel's surface (sem-background-surface, white light / navy-700 dark). Identity in light. Not sem-background-main (taupe) — Amanda's template page is white, unlike the GC-009 taupe demo band.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: gradient-outline endpoints (border-box gradient, all tiles, both states)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: flags.json PENDING-P1 / design-rules 14: the token destination is designer-owned and PENDING ('HEMLOCK MIGRATION PENDING — Amanda will spec the token names', template line 478). Bound to provisional purpose-named local tokens per the never-stop gap doctrine. Deliberately NOT bound to sem-borders-action despite an exact light+dark value match with -from: that role denotes interactive affordance the tiles lack, and value-matching it would pre-empt Amanda's adopt-vs-remap ruling on the treatment (which spans category tiles AND the calculator's KPI tiles, design-rules 12).

tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: color-mix(in oklch, var(--catline-from) 70%, var(--catline-to)) and 35% — computed, not authored constants
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Pen gradients take literal stop colors, so the two computed mixes are materialized as DERIVED local tokens (light #658DFC/#96B2FE from Chromium's own computed oklch values; dark #7094FB/#8BA8FC derived from the dark endpoints by the same mix). They carry no independent design decision — Amanda's endpoint ruling cascades to them mechanically.

The 1.5 ratio exists in the scale as the base-step ratio; bound it rather than minting a duplicate. CROSS-PAIRED: the scale pairs xs(12) with 1.3333 (16px) — the off-step pairing is recorded as a designGap (same pattern GC-009 recorded for its 1.5-on-sub-base copy).
